description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 需要删除的弹幕消息ID的列表。列表的最大长度不得超过100。
description.en: The list of comment message IDs to delete. The maximum length of the list cannot exceed 100.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call CreateRoom.

description.zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了删除弹幕消息的操作。
description.en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the delete comment message operation.
